Class BaseButton

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.inventory.button.BaseButton
All Implemented Interfaces:
Button
public class BaseButton extends Object implements Button
Standard implementation of Button that combines an ItemStack template with configurable click actions and view requirements.

This class is the primary button implementation used throughout KLibrary's inventory system. It supports:

  • Separate click handlers — Different action lists for left-click, right-click, and any-click events
  • View requirements — The button is hidden when any requirement is not met
  • Template cloning — The item template is cloned on each render to prevent shared mutable state

Builder Pattern

Button shopButton = BaseButton.builder()
    .template(ItemStackBuilders.of(Material.EMERALD)
        .with(ItemModifiers.display().name("<green>Buy Sword"))
        .build())
    .leftClick(List.of(buySwordAction))
    .rightClick(List.of(previewAction))
    .viewRequirements(List.of(hasMoneyRequirement))
    .build();

Click Handling

When a player clicks a BaseButton:

  1. The click type is determined (left, right, other)
  2. The corresponding action list is executed (left-click or right-click)
  3. The any-click action list is always executed afterwards

      template - the item template to display; must not be null

  • Method Details

    • getItem

      @NotNull public @NotNull org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack getItem(@NotNull @NotNull InventoryContext context)
      Returns the ItemStack that represents this button in the inventory for the given context.

      This method is called during each inventory update/render cycle. Implementations may return different items based on the context (e.g., player-specific data, current page, or placeholder values).

      The returned item should be a clone or new instance to avoid shared mutable state between renders.

      Returns a clone of the item template. The original template is never mutated.

      Specified by:
      getItem in interface Button
      Parameters:
      context - the current inventory context
      Returns:
      the item stack to display in this button's slot; never null

    • onClick

      public void onClick(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryClickEvent event, @NotNull @NotNull InventoryContext context)
      Handles a player click on this button.

      This method is called after the InventoryHandler has determined that the click targets this button's slot and the button is visible. The click event has already been cancelled by this point.

      Executes the click-type-specific actions first (left or right), then always executes the any-click actions.

      Specified by:
      onClick in interface Button
      Parameters:
      event - the raw Bukkit click event (already cancelled)
      context - the current inventory context

    • isVisible

      public boolean isVisible(@NotNull @NotNull InventoryContext context)
      Determines whether this button should be visible in the given context.

      When this returns false, the button's slot will be empty (or show a fallback item, depending on the provider implementation). Visibility is typically gated by Requirements.

      Evaluates all view requirements. The button is visible only if every requirement is met. An empty requirement list means the button is always visible.

      Specified by:
      isVisible in interface Button
      Parameters:
      context - the current inventory context
      Returns:
      true if the button should be displayed; false to hide it
